briefing: Markets were modestly positive today (NASDAQ +1.1%, S&P500 +0.4%) but not a strong risk-on surge, so we deployed into only our two best fully-confirmed setups (MANE, SYRE) rather than forcing all three open slots. Existing positions are held unchanged per the stop-loss/profit-target rules already in place.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Just because you have cash and open slots doesn't mean you must invest all of it every day. Smart investors only deploy capital when a stock shows strong, confirmed signals — otherwise they wait, keeping some cash in reserve for better opportunities.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 即使手上有現金及空置倉位，也不代表每日都要全數投入。精明的投資者只會在股票出現強勁且經確認的訊號時才動用資金，否則寧願保留現金，等待更好的入市時機。

market_education.summary_en: Equity indices drifted higher today in a broad, low-conviction advance, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500 as growth-oriented names led modestly. No major market-moving headlines were identified in today's screen, so the move looks like routine continuation rather than a reaction to new catalysts. Breadth was positive but unspectacular, consistent with a neutral overall market tone.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股溫和上揚，納指升1.1%，標普500升0.4%，成長股表現稍為領先大盤。由於今日未見重大市場消息或催化劑，這波升勢較似屬慣性延續，而非受突發新聞帶動。大市廣度正面但力度溫和，整體市況維持中性格局。
